[[Paragon Deldrimor armor]] is the collective name used to refer to the stand alone armor pieces crafted for paragons by [[Gobrech Stonefoot]] in [[Central Transfer Chamber]]. It is also sometimes referred to as Dwarven armor.

It is made up of the following pieces:
*[[Paragon Winged Raiment|Winged Raiment]]
*[[Paragon Sashed Leggings|Sashed Leggings]]
*[[Paragon Banded Sandals|Banded Sandals]]

The total cost for all pieces would be 300{{Hide}}, 30{{Leather}} and 30{{plat}}
